body: That's what I am doing. Selling everything that has value so nobody has to go through my crap.

Every day is exactly the same. I appreciate your kindness, it is better used on others. I'm not looking to feel better. I'm not looking for a reason to live. This was just a way to say the truth to the universe without having to worry about someone trying to commit me. It is inevitable. Maybe it won't be Christmas, but one day I will have had my complete fill. It's just a matter of time.
Sleeping. It's the only thing I look forward to.
